# KONNRA — Dongguan Konnra Electronics Co., Ltd.

> KONNRA (Dongguan Konnra Electronics Co., Ltd., established 2004) designs and manufactures electronic connectors and wire harnesses in Dongguan, Guangdong, China. It publishes part-number cross-references to JST, Molex and Hirose series.

## Company facts
- Name: KONNRA
- Legal name: Dongguan Konnra Electronics Co., Ltd.
- Founded: 2004
- Address: No.6 Nanchang South Road, Chijiao, Wangniudun, Dongguan, Guangdong, 523200, China
- Email: sales003@konnra.com
- Phone: +86 153 7007 9692 · Fax: +86-769-85846797
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8613826905495

## Certifications shown on the site (company-reported)
- 45 certificates
- Raw material supply chain with reliable quality system certification.
- 2009: Obtained IS09001 swstem certification
- 2015: ERP system officially on operation Obtained international UL certification
- 2017: Obtained “National high-tech Enterprise Certificate”
- 2018: Obtained IATF16949 quality system certification
- 2021: Precision wiring harness factory was established in Kunshan Several automotive connectors obtained national standard certification &US CAR-2 Purchased headquarters and R&D centre
- 2022: CRM system on operation Set up central China marketing department in Chengdu Obtained the national specialized special certificate
- 2023: Obtained Medical system IS013485 PLM system on operation TPA automotive connectors obtained certificate from LV214&US CAR-2

## Claims as published (company-reported, not independently verified)
- 4 factory bases ensure production capability.
- 45 certificates
- Lead time: connector 2-3 weeks, wiring harness 3-4weeks.
- Raw material supply chain with reliable quality system certification.
- Factory automation rate exceed 95%
- Customized connector and wiring harness R&D one-stop solution
